answer: An applicant enters the delta after locking a 110-unit bond for thirteen days and seating a hollow clay token in the oasis lockbox at the north fork. For four dawns a clerk photographs the token beside a dated water-line mark that must have dropped 6 cm from day one, then stamps a carbon receipt. Two settled delta stewards from non-adjacent forks initial the lockbox lid. Tokens that share a kiln-batch stamp, or photographs that share a camera-body serial, burn both bonds and bench those steward pairs for 24 days. Each oasis lockbox graduates at most one agent every 17 days.
